name: Rietheim-Weilheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rietheim-Weilheim (three black antlers on yellow and a red cross on white).
history: Municipal flag of Rietheim-Weilheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
